name: North Dakota

windshield.strip: nonreflective tint allowed above the AS-1 line or within the top 5 in.; below that the windshield with tint must keep at least 70%

frontSide.note: tint in conjunction with the window (film + glass); changed from 50% to 35% by HB 1340 (2025)

backSide.note: 35% rule does not apply to windows behind the operator if outside mirrors on both sides are fitted (39-21-38); otherwise 35%

rear.note: same: any darkness with outside mirrors on both sides, otherwise 35%

tint.measuredHow: film + glass combined ('in conjunction with the windshield/window')
tint.dualMirrors: Outside mirrors on both sides (meeting 39-21-38) required to exceed the 35% limit on windows behind the operator

medicalExemption.text: No medical exemption in § 39-21-39 as read

penalty.text: Non-criminal traffic violation with a statutory fee (39-06.1-06; specific tint fee not isolated); a violation found while the vehicle is not being operated is listed as non-moving (39-06.1-08)

quotes: has a light transmittance of at least seventy percent or the object, material, or tinting in conjunction with a window other than the windshield ... has a light transmittance of at least thirty-five percent
This subsection does not apply to windows behind the operator if the motor vehicle is equipped with outside mirrors on both sides which meet the requirements of section 39-21-38.
Subsection 4 does not apply to nonreflective sunscreening or window tinting material above the AS-1 line or within the top five inches

helmet.conditions: Operators and riders under 18; if the operator must wear a helmet, any passenger must also wear one regardless of age

handheldPhone.noviceOrAgeBan: Drivers 16-17 with a class D license may not use an electronic communication device while driving (39-08-24)

studdedTires.season: Oct 15 - Apr 15 (studs max 1/16 in.; school buses year-round)

radarDetector.note: No state ban found; commercial vehicles over 10,001 lb banned federally (49 CFR 392.71)

openQuestions: Exact effective date of HB 1340 (2025) not read on an official page (2024 Century Code still said 50%)
A 2026 initiated measure to remove all tint limits failed to qualify (KFYR, 2026-02-25, news source only)
Underglow and lift rules not located
